limitations: HTTP 2xx streamed response fully completed within each 30-second window; drain completions excluded from RPS.
No latency, semantic quality or failure-rate acceptance gate. JSON/reference checks are diagnostic only.
First five L4 configurations and final vLLM32 configuration were measured on different physical GPU UUIDs after a server restart.
All six profiles were measured, but strict same-session/same-GPU six-candidate comparison is incomplete. Cross-session ratios are descriptive.
T4 host had 4 logical CPUs and about 15.4 GiB RAM; L4 host has 8 logical CPUs and about 30.15 GiB RAM. This is not an isolated GPU-only causal comparison.
One run per concurrency step; sustainable arrival capacity, C_SLO and lambda_SLO are not certified.
Nominal Qwen3-4B family is shared, GGUF Q4_K_M vs AWQ model conversion lineage equivalence is unverified.
